Vendored inflate-only dependency: miniz 3.0.2, MIT license.

Upstream: https://github.com/richgel999/miniz/tree/3.0.2

The unmodified upstream files are `miniz_tinfl.c`, `miniz_tinfl.h`,
`miniz_common.h`, `miniz.h`, `miniz_tdef.h`, `miniz_zip.h`, and `LICENSE`.
`miniz_export.h` is the local static-build configuration header.
Only `miniz_tinfl.c` is compiled. No DLL or MATLAB runtime is required.
